changes: Reworked interface: a cleaner, consistent design across every tab, with side-rail navigation, reorganized Settings, and Settings now opening from a cog in the title bar
Apps: install or uninstall straight from an app's right-click menu
Apps: after scanning your installed apps, the Store marks what you already have and offers Uninstall
Faster tab switching: Apps and System no longer gather data just from opening them; load it on demand with the on-screen buttons
New tweaks: Disable WPBT execution, Disable Windows AI, Prevent device metadata download from the network
A broken tab no longer stops Scy from starting; it's skipped and reported
New: optional debug log for troubleshooting (Settings > General)
New: export and import your apps list to back up or share (Settings > Apps & Groups > My apps)
Faster startup: heavy tab work now loads on first visit (~50% quicker launch)
QR code generator: module styles (rounded, extra round, dots) under Advanced options
Apps: add your own apps to the Store via Settings or right-click a search result
Tools: QR advanced options are collapsible and tidier
